newJobs.descriptionText: Status: Onsite. This is an onsite position located at our Plantation Headquarters - 8300 W. Sunrise Blvd, Plantation, FL 33322 Akumin is a leading provider of outpatient radiology and oncology services, partnering with top hospitals and health systems nationwide to deliver advanced diagnostic imaging and exceptional patient care close to home. With a national footprint, cutting-edge technology, and a strong commitment to innovation and patient-centered care, our teams play a vital role in improving outcomes for millions of patients each year. The role of the Field Support Technician is to provide full-time, office-based technical support, serving as the primary physical anchor for our corporate headquarters. Working under a tiered support model, the technician’s primary responsibility is to deliver direct, on-site assistance to staff and systems at the main office, followed by providing local hands-on technical support at our neighboring locations as needed. Additionally, the role is responsible for managing the centralized call queue and IT ticketing system to provide comprehensive remote troubleshooting and support for all other offices, clinical locations, and remote users across the United States. Collaborating closely with the Service Desk, Engineering, and Management teams, this position ensures seamless operations, high system uptime, and prompt resolution of hardware, software, and connectivity issues nationwide. Specific duties include, but are not limited to: Main Office Support (Primary): Provides direct, hands-on, full-time technical support, hardware setup, and troubleshooting for all local users, workstations, peripherals, and network infrastructure at the corporate headquarters. National Remote Support & Queue Management (Tertiary): Manages, prioritizes, and resolves incoming IT support tickets and the centralized call queue, providing remote troubleshooting and support for clinical sites, offices, and remote users across the United States. Local On-Site Support (Secondary): Travels to neighboring office and clinical locations as needed to deliver hands-on technical assistance, hardware deployments, and physical system troubleshooting. Clinical & Corporate Systems Troubleshooting: Troubleshoots workflows, functionality, and remote connectivity issues for clinical systems (such as radiology/imaging systems) and corporate software applications. System Administration & Onboarding: Performs basic system administration, including user account setup and security access management (Active Directory, Okta MFA, Google Workspace), and provides training or technical documentation for end-users. Vendor & Team Collaboration: Collaborates with internal IT and Network Engineering teams on system migrations and deployments, and coordinates with external OEM/hardware vendors to resolve complex local infrastructure issues. Administration & Operations: Monitors local system uptime, assists with IT asset tracking, and performs other duties and projects as assigned by management. Position Requirements: Associate’s Degree Information technology or related field, or 3 years of experience in handling service desk issues will be considered in lieu of associate’s degree. Demonstrated experience managing and prioritizing a high-volume call queue and ticketing system in a fast-paced environment. Intermediate knowledge of Service Desk systems, Citrix, Active Directory, Okta MFA, and O365 / Microsoft 365. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to support remote users and translate technical issues into plain language. Must be able to report to the office full-time. Capable to self-manage and prioritize high volume of tickets in order to assist end users with their technical needs. 100% Travel may be required Preferred: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology. 3–5 years of experience working in an IT support or service desk role. Certificate from College or Technical School: CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft 365 Certified Fundamentals / Modern Desktop Administrator. At Akumin, we invest in the well-being of our employees, so you can bring your best self to work each day. You can expect to see the following benefits: Competitive compensation Flexible scheduling Cross training opportunities Medical, dental, and vision insurance HSA accounts with employer contributions 401(k) eligibility with employer match Paid holidays Defined PTO and sick time programs Eligibility for benefits will vary based on role type and hours worked. newJobs.title: Product Owner - Precision Design System UX/UI
newJobs.descriptionText: Please Note: 1. If you are a first time user, please create your candidate login account before you apply for a job. (Click Sign In > Create Account) 2. If you already have a Candidate Account, please Sign-In before you apply. Job Description: The Product Owner (PO) at Broadcom sits between the Product Manager (PM) and the Development Team. The PO's primary responsibility and value come from understanding and contributing towards the product strategy, and then executing that strategy by breaking down large strategic ideas and intentions into development items with concrete outcomes and then further into manageable work items—such as enablers or user stories—with the development team. The role requires a PO to navigate priorities across the mainframe software portfolio. Broadcom's Precision design system is a modern user interface framework, including both design assets and developer SDK, that delivers a consistent and intuitive user experience adopted by over 35 mainframe products in the Mainframe Software Portfolio. These distinct products are consumers of Precision assets, and by understanding all of the varied personas and use cases along with the value of the capability in the market, the PO is to prioritize features and capabilities across the development roadmap. Delivering user experiences that differentiate from the competition and are realized in the market within the solutions at the right time. This role requires negotiation across value streams and offering teams. The PO is the voice of the customer to the development and engineering processes, ensuring the right work is done at the right time to achieve the best outcomes for our customers—both external users and internal product teams who consume Precision assets. Product Owner Core Responsibilities Operates as part of an extended Product Management team, usually reporting to Product Management. Understands how the Enterprise backlog model operates with Epics, Capabilities, Features, and User Stories. Uses Program Increment (PI) Objectives and Iteration Goals to communicate with management. Establishes and sequences backlog items based on program priorities, events, and dependencies with other teams. Coordinates with other Product Owners, the System Team, and shared services in the Agile Release Train (ART) PI Planning meetings. Works with other Product Owners and the Product Management team throughout each Iteration and PI. The Product Owner owns the Definition of Done (DoD) and sets clear Acceptance Criteria, ultimately holding final authority to accept or reject completed user stories at the end of sprints. Team Backlog Ownership The principal responsibility of the PO is to maintain a backlog of work items with order and detail sufficient for the team to work on for the current and next iteration. A story must satisfy the team’s definition of ready. Cross-Team and Management Reporting To maintain cadence across many teams globally, PO communication is key to ensure inter-team dependencies are communicated and risks to team productivity are shared and mitigated. The PO is responsible for raising information to enable management by exception and is accountable for communication with their PO peers, PM's, engineering managers and Mainframe executives if needed. Customer Engagement Our business success is driven by our customers and in turn by their success. In order to ensure our products solve our customers' challenges we continually iterate on our solutions asking our customers for their feedback. A PO works with their PM and field peers, creating opportunities to visit customers and observe users in their environment whenever possible. Regular Sprint Reviews are one of the responsibilities of the PO who decides when it is appropriate to share progress and with which internal and external stakeholders. In establishing the Sprint Review event, the PO will invite their customers describing the value they may expect to receive. newJobs.descriptionText: 岗位定位 面向电动工具及相关机电系统的下一代技术发展需求，负责先进控制理论、系统建模方法、CAE AI应用及模型驱动开发体系的研究与落地。该岗位将聚焦复杂机电系统的控制与建模前沿方向，探索可转化为产品竞争力和研发效率提升的关键技术，并推动相关研究成果在平台开发、新产品预研和软件开发流程中的工程化应用。 本岗位适合具有扎实控制理论基础、较强科研创新能力和工程转化意识的高层次博士人才。 核心职责 1. 前沿控制与系统建模研究 面向电动工具及相关复杂机电系统，开展先进控制理论、系统建模方法和智能化研发技术研究。 研究鲁棒控制、自适应控制、优化控制、智能控制、数据驱动建模等方向在实际产品中的应用潜力。 跟踪国内外前沿技术发展趋势，识别对未来产品平台和研发体系具有战略价值的关键技术方向。 2. CAE AI与智能工程方法探索 探索CAE与AI融合技术在产品设计、性能预测、参数优化、故障分析和研发提效中的应用。 推动仿真驱动、数据驱动和模型驱动方法在电动工具研发中的结合应用。 研究面向复杂系统的智能建模、代理模型、参数识别、虚拟验证等新方法。 3. 基于System Modeling的软件开发方法建设 推动基于System Modeling / Model-Based Development的软件开发方法在控制系统开发中的应用。 建立从系统需求、功能建模、控制设计、仿真验证到软件实现的开发流程与方法框架。 支持控制策略、系统架构和软件实现之间的一致性设计与验证。 4. 研究成果工程化转化 将前沿研究成果转化为可复用的研发方法、分析工具、建模规范、设计标准和技术平台能力。 支持研发团队将先进控制与建模方法应用于新产品开发、平台开发和关键技术攻关。 与机械、电子、电机、软件、测试等团队协同，推动研究成果在工程场景中的落地与验证。 5. 技术影响力与创新体系建设 参与或主导高水平技术课题、联合研究项目和外部技术合作。 推动专利、论文、技术白皮书、内部方法论和标准体系建设。 为团队提供系统控制、建模仿真和智能研发方向的技术指导，提升组织在前沿技术领域的能力积累。 任职资格 教育背景 博士学历，控制科学与工程、电气工程、自动化、系统工程、机电控制、机械电子工程或相关专业。 优先考虑国内外Top高校或知名研究团队背景。 研究与工作经验 具备先进控制、系统建模、模型驱动开发、智能控制、CAE相关方向的深入研究基础。 有复杂机电系统、电驱系统、机器人、汽车电控、工业装备、航空航天控制或相关领域研究/开发经验者优先。 具备将理论研究转化为工程方法、工具链或产品能力的经验者优先。 有高水平论文、核心专利、重大科研项目或产学研合作经历者优先。 专业能力 具备扎实的控制理论基础，对系统动力学、建模、控制与优化有深入理解。 熟悉一种或多种先进控制方法，如鲁棒控制、自适应控制、最优控制、预测控制、智能控制等。 熟悉系统建模、仿真分析和模型驱动开发方法，能够建立复杂系统的分析与设计框架。 了解CAE工具链、数据驱动方法、AI在工程研发中的应用逻辑。 具备较强的软件思维，理解控制算法到软件实现的转化过程。 具备优秀的科研能力、问题抽象能力、技术判断能力和跨团队协同能力。 优先条件 有MATLAB/Simulink、Modelica、AMESim、Ansys Twin Builder、Python或相关建模/仿真/算法工具使用经验。 有数字孪生、虚拟验证、代理模型、参数辨识、智能优化等方向经验者优先。 有电动工具、园林工具、手持设备或高动态机电产品相关经验者优先。 有技术路线规划、平台方法建设或研究团队带领经验者优先。 关键产出方向 前沿控制与系统建模方向的技术突破与方法沉淀 CAE AI与模型驱动开发在研发流程中的应用落地 支撑新产品平台开发的建模、分析与控制方法体系 高价值专利、论文、技术标准及内部研发资产 组织在先进控制与智能工程方向的能力提升 We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too. Job Description: Wireless Semiconductor Division (WSD) Fab Test Engineering has an immediate opening for a Principal Test Engineer. In this specific position as a WSD Fab Test Unit Process Engineer (TUPE), you will have primary equipment ownership of one to several test tool groups with a multiplicity of individual tools per group. The tool groups consist of replicated, custom, semi-custom, or purchased wafer level probers and testers performing analog DC, Linear and Non-Linear RF parametric (sampled) and wafer sort (100%) measurements. These tools are used to characterize and measure advanced silicon based MEMs wafers for development and production. The TUPE is responsible for the hardware system design and \ or specification of the tool. Each tool can be a turnkey system purchased externally, or build as a custom\semi-custom system from purchased or custom designed components and instruments. The TUPE is responsible for specifying and verifying the measurement capability of each element. The TUPE also writes the software needed to setup, interface, configure and run the testers as well as interface with the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) data systems. One of the most important items in the scope and role of the Test Unit Process Engineer (TUPE) is to fully understand the technical details of the test that is being performed and the technical details of the test equipment with which the measurement is being made. An additional critical criteria for the TUPE is to understand the accuracy and the repeatability or variance of the test being performed. Both of these critical fundamentals allow the test engineer to distinguish between the measurement system and the product being measured as a gauge of test quality. As a WSD Fab Test Unit Process Engineer (TUPE), you will have a mix of both tactical and strategic responsibilities. The tactical responsibilities of the TUPE are to keep the owned test tool sets functioning as expected ensuring the continuous flow of lots and wafers through the various test operations. This generally consists of review and resolution of the control charts, calibration coefficients, and reference wafer results of the test systems, as well as reviewing and resolving lot/wafer holds and dispositions that are tester related. The strategic responsibilities of the TUPE can be continuous improvement projects, enhanced capability or migration, or completely new measurement requirements driven by new technology required for R&D or NPI and intended for the owned test system tool sets. Assignments can be complex and variable in nature and require judgment, initiative, and technical/specialized knowledge. newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Sports is one of the internet’s leading destinations for comprehensive sports news and innovative fantasy games. We produce insightful content across multiple platforms and curate quality coverage from around the web to inform and entertain fans. We're an original fantasy sports pioneer, with a legacy of innovation that helps us continue to be a fantasy leader. And as one of the most-visited sports platforms on the internet, we're one of the best places for brands to reach fans. Yahoo Media Group Principal Product Manager – Revenue Growth & Monetization A Little About Us Part of Yahoo Media Group brings two of Yahoo's most iconic brands, Yahoo Finance and Yahoo Sports, connecting millions of users with the content, tools, and experiences they're passionate about. Yahoo Finance is the world's #1 finance destination, empowering over 150 million monthly visitors globally with trusted financial news, real-time market data, research, and powerful tools to make financial decisions with confidence.Yahoo Sports is a premier destination for sports news, content, and fantasy gaming. As an original fantasy sports pioneer, Yahoo Sports continues to innovate across its digital sports ecosystem, delivering engaging experiences that connect fans with the teams, leagues, and communities they love. Our Revenue Product team works across both brands to identify, develop, and optimize monetization opportunities, building scalable solutions that maximize revenue growth while delivering a high-quality user experience. AI is embedded into how we build products, enabling our teams to move faster, work more autonomously, and accelerate the path from ideas to production. We're looking for someone who embraces modern AI tools and workflows to drive efficiency, experimentation, and innovation throughout the product development lifecycle. The Role As a Principal Product Manager, Revenue Growth & Monetization for Yahoo Media Group, you'll own and drive a product roadmap focused on maximizing revenue yield across Yahoo Finance and Yahoo Sports. While advertising and supply optimization remain core to the role, your scope will extend across multiple revenue streams, including strategic partnerships and reserved sales. You'll balance analytical rigor with creative thinking, driving data-backed programmatic optimizations while developing innovative monetization solutions that unlock new revenue opportunities. This includes optimizing ad placements and rendering logic to developing flexible onsite promotional frameworks, audience targeting capabilities, and new monetization experiences. You'll work closely with engineering, design, analytics, sales, business development, and other product teams to prioritize opportunities, rapidly experiment, and deliver measurable revenue impact. This is a hands-on, AI-enabled product role. You'll be expected to leverage AI tooling throughout the product development lifecycle to accelerate research, data analysis, prototyping, technical discovery, documentation, and execution. We're looking for someone who can do more with modern tooling, challenge traditional workflows, and operate with a high degree of autonomy. This role reports to the Director of Revenue Product. Enough About Us, What About You? You: Are obsessed with data and business outcomes. You love digging into performance data, identifying opportunities, and translating insights into measurable revenue growth. Think holistically about monetization. You understand that every placement and user interaction has value, and can evaluate opportunities across advertising, subscriptions, commerce, and partnerships rather than optimizing each in isolation. Are technically fluent and AI-forward. You're comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical systems, and using AI tools to accelerate your own productivity and product development workflows. Move quickly and independently. You thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve, opportunities emerge unexpectedly, and rapid experimentation matters. Balance revenue and user experience. You understand the tradeoffs between monetization, engagement, site performance, and long-term user value. Are a strong cross-functional partner. You can influence stakeholders, navigate competing business priorities, and communicate effectively from high-level strategy down to technical requirements. And, most importantly, you are a team player who enjoys motivating others to work together towards common goals. Are both strategic and hands-on. You can identify the right opportunities to pursue and do the detailed work required to bring them to market. You Must Have 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in digital media, advertising technology, monetization, or revenue growth. Demonstrated experience developing and executing product initiatives that drive measurable revenue growth across web and/or mobile applications. Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, ad serving, inventory management, and yield optimization. Experience leveraging analytics and experimentation platforms to uncover revenue optimization opportunities, develop and test hypotheses, and translate performance insights into actionable product improvements. Testing and data is core to this team. Proficiency using AI-assisted tools in day-to-day product development workflows, with the ability to independently accelerate research, analysis, prototyping, requirements development, and delivery. Technical fluency sufficient to collaborate closely with engineering on frontend code requirements, APIs, integrations, instrumentation, and platform capabilities. Proven ability to operate autonomously, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Nice to Have Experience with Google Ad Manager, Prebid, SSP integrations, and programmatic advertising infrastructure. Experience developing onsite monetization or promotional frameworks supporting multiple business initiatives. Familiarity with first-party audience targeting, segmentation, and privacy-conscious monetization strategies. Experience with AI-assisted coding, prototyping, SQL generation, or building lightweight internal tools to accelerate product discovery and development. Understanding of direct-sold advertising, campaign operations, revenue forecasting, and commercial product packaging. Experience working across digital media, sports, fantasy gaming, financial services, or other large-scale consumer platforms. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®. Familiarity with agile delivery and tooling (Jira/Azure DevOps) and ITSM (ServiceNow). Experience with global template design, regional rollouts, and change management/adoption. Strong SQL/data validation skills and familiarity with BI tools (Power BI/Tableau). Strong experience translating business needs into epics/features/user stories and functional specifications. Proven leadership in testing and release readiness (UAT leadership, defect triage, go-live/hypercare). Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal. newJobs.descriptionText: It takes powerful technology to connect our brands and partners with an audience of hundreds of millions of people. Whether you’re looking to write mobile app code, engineer the servers behind our massive ad tech stacks, or develop algorithms to help us process trillions of data points a day, what you do here will have a huge impact on our business—and the world. About the Team Identity platforms at Yahoo provide modern, secure identity offerings for consumers and businesses interacting with Yahoo systems. These platforms operate at massive scale, serving hundreds of millions of users every day, and power critical authentication, authorization, and account management capabilities across Yahoo products. As part of Yahoo’s transition to an AI-First engineering model, teams increasingly leverage AI-assisted development environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) combined with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflows, to accelerate delivery while maintaining high engineering quality. About the Role We are looking for a Full Stack Software Dev Engineer II to join our Identity organization. You will work across the stack to build secure, scalable, and user-friendly authentication and account management experiences that serve hundreds of millions of users globally. In this role, you will work independently with minimal guidance, owning critical features and acting as a technical resource for your peers. A core expectation is the ability to collaborate effectively with AI systems—using structured specs, deep codebase context, and prompt modeling to guide high-quality software implementation. We seek engineers who possess an experimentation-forward mindset and view AI as a force multiplier for architectural excellence and team-wide productivity. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate secure, scalable full-stack identity systems using ReactJS, TypeScript, Java, and Node.js. Own complex features and standalone project phases end-to-end, from gathering requirements and systems design to implementation, testing, and production. Lead an AI-first development workflow within the squad, writing precise markdown specifications to drive AI-assisted code generation (Cursor, Claude Code), and taking responsibility for the rigorous validation, testing, and safety of all generated assets. Identify system bottlenecks, enhance platform reliability, and debug complex production issues in our high-traffic distributed identity systems. Proactively research and implement AI-driven efficiencies in your daily coding workflows, replacing repetitive manual tasks with structured automation, custom templates, and AI-assisted testing. Act as a technical resource for the team by sharing successful prompt engineering patterns, context modeling strategies, and workflow optimizations that level up the overall engineering velocity of the squad. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Managers, UX Designers, Security Engineers, and other Yahoo product squads to coordinate technical integrations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 4–6 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience. Strong hands-on engineering experience using Java for robust backend services. Experience building responsive, high-performance web applications using React.js, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as Next.js. Strong core engineering fundamentals in distributed system design, API development, databases, and web security. Demonstrated experience integrating AI-assisted developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) into day-to-day software development workflows to build and refactor production-grade systems. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, model limitations, and structured context assembly to generate robust code outputs. Proven capability to evaluate, audit, and debug AI-generated outputs, ensuring alignment with Yahoo’s high standards for code quality, security protocols, and performance. Experience with testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing production-ready, highly maintainable tests. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or maintaining high-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems, auth protocols (OAuth, OIDC, SAML), or web security standards. Cloud platform experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code. Familiarity with observability tools (Splunk, Grafana) and client/server performance profiling. Experience with structured development methodologies, such as Spec-Driven Development (SDD), API-first design, or AI-assisted diagnostic tools. Exposure to web accessibility (WCAG), internationalization, or large-scale consumer product delivery. What Success Looks Like Consistently deliver high-quality, high-impact features independently, ensuring secure user authentication experiences for hundreds of millions of users. Masterfully leverage AI-assisted tools to significantly compress development lifecycles while maintaining an ultra-high bar for security compliance and test coverage. Raise overall engineering standards by contributing to system architecture discussions, documenting clear technical specifications, and mentoring junior engineers. Accelerate squad velocity by sharing innovative, repeatable ways to integrate AI workflows into daily development, testing, and troubleshooting activities. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

newJobs.descriptionText: Stanley Leadership Development Program – Software Engineering - Motor Control Towson, MD | New Britain, CT Come make the world and accelerate your success. It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of more than 50,000 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®. Why SLP? The Stanley Black & Decker Leadership Development Program (“SLP”) is a high-profile rotational program that is an integrated process for accelerating the development of our future leaders. It is geared toward recent graduates with Human Resources internship experience and a relevant business degree with a passion for a long-term career in Human Resources and People Operations. Engineering SLPs work in three 8-month rotations in Engineering, Product Management and Operations at different facilities across the United States. Each rotation has project assignments that allow participants to become familiar with how we do business and contribute to the success of that facility. The program offers invaluable experiences for early-career associates seeking challenging developmental opportunities to jump-start their careers. Our program offers invaluable experiences for early-career associates seeking challenging developmental opportunities to jump-start their careers. The Job: As a part of the SLP program, you’ll be part of our Engineering team. You’ll get to: Design and develop electronic firmware and specifications for power tools including brushless DC motor controls, Li-Ion battery management systems and battery chargers. Implement and validate electronic designs through software development, test and simulation. Develop software verification and validation procedures using unit and integration tests. Provide leadership in achieving cost, performance and quality objectives of all related electronic systems, components and sub-assemblies. Develop solutions for electronic systems related issues as an integral member of a larger team. Maintain appropriate documentation for work performed. Translate customer requirements into software specifications. Embrace cross functional team work. The Person: You love to learn, grow, and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. You also have Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or Computer Engineering from an accredited computer or electrical engineering college. Knowledge in developing embedded 8bit/16bit/32bit microcontrollers in C. Experience with ARM architectures preferred, experience with assembly language a plus. Understanding of common microcontroller peripherals such as timers, GPIO, watchdog, ADC, UART, DMA. Strong understanding of embedded concepts, including real-time processing, process scheduling, cooperative multitasking, interrupted processing, race conditions, RTOS. Familiarity with closed loop control and feedback systems, lithium ion battery powered systems and common motor control techniques including sensored and sensorless trapezoidal control is a plus. Familiar with software development processes and control (static analysis, distributed version control, unit testing, bug tracking) Experience with debugging, either in-circuit debugger or by other means. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship (H1B, OPT/CPT, TN etc). The Details: Must be willing to rotate work assignments, projects, and teams every 8 months throughout the program. Relocation for a minimum of one rotation may be required; relocation assistance is available. This hybrid role will begin in either New Britain, CT or Towson, MD Medical, dental, life, vision, wellness program, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement. Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs. And More: You’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us! All qualified applicants to Stanley Black & Decker are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran’s status or any other protected characteristic. The Salary range for this position is $60,000.00 - $96,600.00 This is the lowest to highest annual full-time salary range we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. The salary offered within the range may vary depending on multiple factors including job level, geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience and in compliance with local wage requirements. Please note that salary is only one component of total rewards at Stanley Black & Decker. ​ The salary range listed in this job posting reflects the range for the primary location specified. The salary range may vary for other locations.​ The successful candidate may be eligible for annual merit increases. ​ Medical, dental, life, vision, disability,401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being. ​ Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tool sand other partner programs. We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too. Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights. Who We Are We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company. What You’ll Also Get Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths. Benefits & Perks You’ll get a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits plan that includes medical, dental, life, vision, wellness program, disability, retirement benefits, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Paid Time Off, including paid vacation, holidays & personal days, and tuition reimbursement. And, of course, discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and products and well as discount programs for many other vendors and partners. Learning & Development: Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities). Diverse & Inclusive Culture: We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too. Purpose-Driven Company: You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices. The Job: As a Lead Systems Analyst, you’ll be part of our IT – Supply Chain team working as a remote employee. You’ll get to: Serve as the functional/technical lead for the Procurement technology product area, partnering with Procurement Business Process Owners to define vision, roadmap, and measurable outcomes (cycle time, compliance, touchless processing, supplier enablement). Own and maintain the product backlog (features/user stories), including prioritization, refinement, and alignment to business value and capacity. Lead discovery and solution shaping for S2C and P2P initiatives; drive decisions across process standardization vs. local variation. Drive AI and automation initiatives across S2C and P2P to improve user experience, increase compliance, reduce cycle times, and enable touchless processing (e.g., workflow automation, intelligent intake, guided buying, PO/PR/invoice automation, and spend/supplier insights). Act as the project functional/technical lead for implementations, rollouts, and major enhancements (global/regional), coordinating requirements, design, testing, cutover, and adoption. Lead cross-functional workshops to define future-state processes and confirm impacts across Procurement, Finance/AP, and upstream/downstream systems. Manage functional risks, dependencies, and scope trade-offs; ensure delivery quality and readiness. Own end-to-end requirements: business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, control requirements, and acceptance criteria. Design and standardize processes across:S2C: sourcing events, supplier onboarding/qualification, supplier lifecycle management, contract authoring/approvals, contract repository, and compliance workflows. P2P: catalogs/guided buying, requisitioning, approvals, PO lifecycle, receiving, invoicing, matching, exceptions, and supplier enablement. Ensure solutions support auditability and key controls (e.g., approval traceability, delegation, tolerance rules, segregation of duties, retention). Provide functional oversight for configuration of Ariba (or similar) modules and related workflows, catalogs, and supplier enablement settings. Lead functional definition for integrations between the S2P suite and multiple ERPs (SAP, Infor, QAD, JDE), including: Supplier/master data synchronization and POs, receipts, invoices, status updates and exceptions Partner with integration teams (iPaaS/ESB/API) and data/BI teams to validate mappings, reconciliation, and reporting needs (spend, compliance, operational KPIs). Typical Systems & Modules in Scope S2C: sourcing, supplier lifecycle/onboarding, contract lifecycle management (CLM), approvals, compliance P2P: catalogs/guided buying, requisitions, approvals, PO management, receiving, invoicing/e-invoicing, matching, exceptions ERP integration: SAP, Infor, QAD, JDE (multi-ERP operating model) Reporting: spend analytics, compliance, cycle time, exception, aging Integration protocols: APIs, EDI, cXML, ETL processes The Person: You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or equivalent experience. 8+ years of functional/technical experience sitting at the intersection of enterprise business system analysis and tech procurement pipelines supporting enterprise applications. 2+ years Low-Code/No-Code hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready low-code applications and automated workflows Hands-on experience with S2P Platforms like SAP Ariba/GEP/Coupa/Ivalua or similar platforms across S2C and/or P2P modules. Experience integrating S2P tools with SAP, Infor, QAD, and/or JD Edwards (including master data and transactional flows). Familiarity with agile delivery and tooling (Jira/Azure DevOps) and ITSM (ServiceNow). Experience with global template design, regional rollouts, and change management/adoption. Strong SQL/data validation skills and familiarity with BI tools (Power BI/Tableau). Strong experience translating business needs into epics/features/user stories and functional specifications. Proven leadership in testing and release readiness (UAT leadership, defect triage, go-live/hypercare). newJobs.title: Principal Architect
newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. A Little About Us Yahoo Mail is the second largest email provider in the world, serving hundreds of millions of users at staggering scale. We are undergoing a massive Digital Transformation, moving toward an AI-native and Agentic future. This role is the technical North Star for that journey, defining how we architect systems that are not just "cloud-native," but "AI-first." Responsibilities Strategic Architecture & AI Transformation: Own the 3–5 year vision for Yahoo Mail. Lead the transition from deterministic legacy systems to non-deterministic, agentic architectures, ensuring that AI is woven into the fabric of our storage, search, and delivery layers. Internet-Scale Systems Design: Architect distributed systems handling billions of daily events. Optimize high-scale data pipelines to support real-time RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and agentic reasoning at the edge. AI-Augmented Engineering Excellence: Define the standards for AI-assisted engineering across the organization. Proactively identify opportunities to replace manual architectural bottlenecks with AI-driven automation, from code generation to automated root-cause analysis of system failures. Technical Governance & AI Oversight: Chair architecture reviews. Establish the rigorous validation frameworks required to ensure AI-generated architectural patterns meet Yahoo’s standards for security, cost-efficiency, and 99.99% availability. Executive Influence: Act as a trusted advisor to the ELT. Frame technical investments not just as "infrastructure builds," but as "capability accelerators" driven by AI-augmented oversight. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 15+ years of engineering experience, with a track record of leading architecture for systems with 100M+ users. 3-5+ years of experience leading AI/LLM-led transformations, specifically in moving large-scale enterprises toward agentic or autonomous system behaviors. Deep expertise in managing the intersection of traditional distributed systems and AI platforms (e.g., Vertex AI, SageMaker, or custom LLM orchestration). A commitment to experimentation with AI-driven developer productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to lead the organization by example. Demonstrated ability to influence at the VP/SVP level and represent Yahoo in external technical forums. Preferred Qualifications Experience with multi-cloud resiliency for AI workloads. Expertise in prompt engineering for complex system diagnostics and the governance of AI-agent permissions within a regulated environment. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

With a national footprint, cutting-edge technology, and a strong commitment to innovation and patient-centered care, our teams play a vital role in improving outcomes for millions of patients each year. RIS Application Analyst Responsible for the design, optimization, integration, and ongoing support of enterprise radiology workflows across RIS and PACS platforms. This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in Royal Health RIS and eRAD RIS/PACS, with a strong understanding of end-to-end imaging operations and revenue cycle dependencies. This individual operates as a combination of product manager, workflow architect and systems integrator, ensuring that scheduling, order management, exam execution, reporting, and billing processes are standardized, scalable, and aligned with organizational financial and clinical objectives. In this role you’ll enable a streamlined patient experience, scalability, data integrity, and financial performance. It is a uniquely impactful opportunity to shape and standardize processes, and establishing a modern, interoperable foundation that supports growth, innovation, and care delivery across the enterprise. Specific duties include, but are not limited to: Leading configuration and optimization of RIS platforms (Royal Health, eRAD) across multi-site environments Standardizing radiology workflows: order → scheduling → pre-authorization → exam → interpretation → report delivery → billing Design and maintenance of procedure catalogs (CPT), exam protocols, and scheduling rules aligned to operational and RCM goals Identify and remediate workflow bottlenecks impacting throughput, turnaround time (TAT), and patient access Collaborate with interoperability & PACS team members in message validation, routing, and error handling Align RIS configuration with revenue cycle requirements (CPT accuracy, ICD-10 linkage, charge capture) Implementation & Migration Leadership Lead or support RIS migrations, consolidations, and upgrades Coordinate with vendors and stakeholders to manage timelines and dependencies Drive go-live readiness, testing (UAT), and hypercare support Support ongoing operations, and break-fix needs connected to service levels for the business Position Requirements: 5+ years of experience required. Candidates must have with experience in the healthcare industry clinical applications such as PACS and RIS systems. Familiarity with eRad and Royal Health strongly desired. Strong knowledge of clinical workflow and best practices in Radiology (HL7, DICOM, and RIS-PACS-EMR integrations) Position requires familiarity with standard concepts, practices, and procedures within IT field. Strong communications skills required. You’re a team player and you’re ready to work on technology outcomes that directly impact patient experience and care. Core Competencies & Characteristics Workflow Engineering, understanding impacts to information capture and standardization Systems Thinking, attributing the big picture to the ongoing build Technical Troubleshooting, a knack for forensics Consistent and Positive Stakeholder Communication Execution Discipline, drives projects and issues to completion Why this Role Matters This role transforms our current state into a business orchestration engine, enabling scalable growth, improved patient and provider access, and optimizes revenue cycle performance. The perfect candidate will look at the care journey horizontally and translate operational requirements patient and provider experience. At Akumin, we invest in the well-being of our employees, so you can bring your best self to work each day. Sunrise Blvd, Plantation, FL 33322 Akumin is a leading provider of outpatient radiology and oncology services, partnering with top hospitals and health systems nationwide to deliver advanced diagnostic imaging and exceptional patient care close to home. The role of the Field Support Technician is to provide full-time, office-based technical support, serving as the primary physical anchor for our corporate headquarters. Working under a tiered support model, the technician’s primary responsibility is to deliver direct, on-site assistance to staff and systems at the main office, followed by providing local hands-on technical support at our neighboring locations as needed. Additionally, the role is responsible for managing the centralized call queue and IT ticketing system to provide comprehensive remote troubleshooting and support for all other offices, clinical locations, and remote users across the United States. Collaborating closely with the Service Desk, Engineering, and Management teams, this position ensures seamless operations, high system uptime, and prompt resolution of hardware, software, and connectivity issues nationwide. Specific duties include, but are not limited to: Main Office Support (Primary): Provides direct, hands-on, full-time technical support, hardware setup, and troubleshooting for all local users, workstations, peripherals, and network infrastructure at the corporate headquarters. Local On-Site Support (Secondary): Travels to neighboring office and clinical locations as needed to deliver hands-on technical assistance, hardware deployments, and physical system troubleshooting. Clinical & Corporate Systems Troubleshooting: Troubleshoots workflows, functionality, and remote connectivity issues for clinical systems (such as radiology/imaging systems) and corporate software applications. System Administration & Onboarding: Performs basic system administration, including user account setup and security access management (Active Directory, Okta MFA, Google Workspace), and provides training or technical documentation for end-users. Vendor & Team Collaboration: Collaborates with internal IT and Network Engineering teams on system migrations and deployments, and coordinates with external OEM/hardware vendors to resolve complex local infrastructure issues. Administration & Operations: Monitors local system uptime, assists with IT asset tracking, and performs other duties and projects as assigned by management. Position Requirements: Associate’s Degree Information technology or related field, or 3 years of experience in handling service desk issues will be considered in lieu of associate’s degree. Demonstrated experience managing and prioritizing a high-volume call queue and ticketing system in a fast-paced environment. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to support remote users and translate technical issues into plain language. Must be able to report to the office full-time. This role is focused on building and applying system models to support product development, requirements decomposition, system behavior definition, verification planning, and validation execution for electrical and electronic systems. The position is intended for an engineer with a strong foundation in Model-Based Design (MBD), systems engineering, and verification and validation (V&V), with the ability to support cross-functional teams through the full product development lifecycle. The engineer will work closely with development, testing, controls, hardware, firmware, and integration teams to improve design quality, accelerate issue resolution, and strengthen confidence in system performance before and during physical validation. Stanley Black & Decker (NYSE: SWK) is seeking a Principal Engineer to serve as a strategic individual contributor shaping the vision, development, and implementation of AI initiatives within Engineering. This role sits within the Engineering organization and applies AI directly to product engineering, embedded controls development, and engineering shared services (CAE, PLM, test and validation, requirements management). Candidates should come from a product engineering or R&D background with hands-on AI/ML application. You’ll get to: Architect AI-driven solutions embedded in the product engineering lifecycle: CAD/PLM data, embedded firmware and controls development, and test/validation workflows. Apply AI/ML to mechatronic systems and embedded controls e.g., predictive diagnostics, sensor fusion, and motor/battery control optimization for power tool platforms. Develop digital twins and physics-informed / surrogate models that connect CAE and simulation data with AI to accelerate design iteration. Partner with product engineering, controls/firmware teams, and manufacturing engineering to define solution requirements and technical specifications. Build AI capabilities for engineering shared services: automated workflows, design-for-reliability analytics, and simulation-assisted design. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product management, data science, and IT) to define solution requirements and technical specifications. Coordinate and oversea the end-to-end implementation of AI projects for product engineering, from ideation and prototyping to deployment and monitoring. Evaluate and select appropriate AI technologies, frameworks, and tools appropriate to embedded and engineering-domain constraints.. Guide and mentor engineering teams on AI/ML model integration, data pipelines, and cloud deployment strategies. Develop and maintain AI roadmaps for engineering. newJobs.descriptionText: Lead / Principal - Mechanism & Multi-Body Dynamics Engineer -Hybrid This is a hybrid position and requires onsite work at our Towson, MD Design Center 3 days per week. Towson, MD, United States Come build something that matters. It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®. The Job: Stanley Black & Decker is seeking a Principal Mechanism & Multi-Body Dynamics Engineer to support the development of next-generation industrial equipment and drilling tool platforms through advanced simulation, analysis, and model-based engineering. This role is responsible for building and validating multi-body dynamic models of mechanical systems, including drivetrains, linkages, impact mechanisms, rotating assemblies, and motion transmission systems, to improve product performance, durability, and design robustness. As a Lead / Principal - Mechanism & Multi-Body Dynamics Engineer, you’ll be part of our Tools & Outdoor team working as a hybrid employee. You’ll get to: Develop, maintain, and refine kinematic and dynamic models of mechanical systems using MBD tools such as MSC Adams, MotionSolve, Ansys Motion, RecurDyn, or Simscape Multibody. Perform subsystem and system-level analysis of drivetrains, linkages, gear trains, actuation systems, impact mechanisms, rotating assemblies, and related mechanism-driven hardware. Build and integrate flexible body models through FEA-MBD co-simulation workflows using tools such as ANSYS, LS-DYNA, NASTRAN, or RADIOSS. Generate load cases, interface forces, joint reactions, torque histories, and transient event data for structural, durability, and fatigue analysis teams. Support mechanism-specific modeling for products involving power transmission, motion conversion, latch/lock systems, clutching elements, and high-speed or high-load dynamic events. Correlate simulation outputs against bench, subsystem, and full-system physical test data, and update models to improve predictive accuracy. Conduct DOE, sensitivity studies, and parameter sweeps to optimize mechanism performance and improve robustness across operating conditions. Collaborate with mechanical design teams to define assumptions for joints, contacts, friction, damping, stiffness, inertia properties, and boundary conditions. Support co-simulation workflows including FMI/FMU-based frameworks and Adams-Simulink co-simulation where plant dynamics influence system behavior. Develop scripts and automation tools using Python, MATLAB, or Adams/View macro scripting to improve model setup, post-processing, and reporting. Document model assumptions, validation methods, simulation results, and recommendations in a review-ready format for cross-functional stakeholders. The Person: You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have: Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Engineering Mechanics, or a related technical field. Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in mechanism analysis, multi-body dynamics, or simulation of mechanical systems; advanced degree may offset a portion of experience. 10+ years of relevant CAE experience in product development Demonstrated experience with one or more commercial MBD tools such as MSC Adams, MotionSolve, Ansys Motion, RecurDyn, or Simscape Multibody. Strong fundamentals in rigid body dynamics, kinematics, Lagrangian mechanics, constraint systems, contact mechanics, and force element modeling. Experience developing models for mechanical systems with multiple moving bodies, joints, contacts, and nonlinear interactions. Experience creating simulation outputs that support structural analysis, fatigue assessment, wear or durability engineering. Experience correlating simulation predictions with physical test data and improving models based on measured results. Working knowledge of flexible body modeling and interaction between MBD and finite element representations. Proficiency in technical scripting or automation using Python, MATLAB, or equivalent tools. Working knowledge of structured coding languages C#, C++ or equivalent. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively across design, test, and analysis functions. Preferred Qualifications: Mechanism Design Background Experience designing or supporting the design of mechanisms, drivetrains, gear systems, linkages, cams, clutches, or actuation hardware. Strong understanding of mechanical packaging, tolerance effects, manufacturability, assembly constraints, and real-world hardware behavior. Ability to translate CAD-based product architecture into efficient and representative simulation models. Experience working directly with product development teams to influence mechanism concept selection, layout decisions, and design tradeoffs. Familiarity with industrial equipment, power tools, drilling tools, or other ruggedized hardware operating in demanding environments. Pure Simulation Background Deep experience in high-fidelity MBD model development, solver setup, numerical troubleshooting, and model correlation. Experience with FEA-MBD coupling, modal reduction techniques, and flexible body generation using ANSYS, LS-DYNA, ABAQUS, NASTRAN, or RADIOSS. Familiarity with co-simulation frameworks such as FMI/FMU and Adams-Simulink co-simulation. Advanced experience performing DOE, sensitivity analysis, optimization studies, and performance trade studies for mechanism tuning and robustness. Experience supporting simulation-driven decisions for durability, transient events, vibration response, or dynamic load management. The Job: The Systems Model Based Development Engineer will lead the development of advanced plant models, simulation frameworks, and engineering applications supporting next-generation electromechanical product development. You’ll get to: Lead development of high-fidelity plant models for complex electromechanical systems using Dymola, TwinBuilder, Amesim, Modelica, Simulink, and Simscape or equivalent tools. Develop multi-scale and multi-domain models spanning component, subsystem, and system-level behavior across electrical, mechanical, thermal, hydraulic, pneumatic, and controls-coupled domains. Job Description: Software Engineer Broadcom provides IT management solutions that help customers manage and secure complex IT environments to support agile business services. It’s our aim to encourage global collaboration and innovation while supporting and developing our talented workforce. Broadcom empowers its employees to drive success for both the business and themselves. Broadcom has earned scores of global Workplace Excellence awards in the last few years - and there's a reason for that. Our fun, diverse, and fast-paced corporate culture has put us on the map as one of the best employers in the industry. Here you'll have the opportunity to explore flexible work arrangements, partner with our impressive customer set, and enjoy a competitive compensation package - all while pushing the boundaries of what's "possible" by collaborating with a diverse team of global innovators. The Opportunity The Broadcom Datacom development team in Plano, Texas develops a leading Database product Datacom, has been around since the early 1970s, designed for large, mission-critical workloads on IBM mainframes; driving some of the world’s largest banks, insurance companies, retailers and more. Datacom is a high-performance relational database management system for IBM z Systems. It is built for reliability and can handle massive critical workloads with 24x7 availability. It includes features like Datacom SQL and Datacom Server, which enable integration with modern applications, business intelligence, web services, and cloud environments using JDBC and ODBC connections. Clearly, this demands exceptional innovation from the best and brightest minds - which is where you come in. Who You Are In an arena where ideas and original thought are highly prized - and initiative, innovation and technical excellence are lauded - you'll need to be a self-motivated team player with a strong computer science background. You'll also need to be dynamic in thought, adaptable in style, and brave enough to think outside of the box and open to learn new tool and technologies - all in the name of developing the next-generation of world class IT solutions. To be part of our team - the brains behind the world's leading Database software - you'll need to be bold, decisive, and have a true desire to partner and collaborate with like-minded, creative colleagues, every single day. What You’ll Do Research and develop innovative new solutions that will help to shape the future direction of Broadcom. Job Description: We are seeking a highly talented and experienced Senior AI Fabric Performance Engineer to take on a critical role within our Performance Lab. You will be responsible to generate reports that aid the customers in deployment and marketing team to position the product. While the AI workloads (inference and training) run on our servers, your primary focus will be optimizing the Ethernet fabric that connects them. Strong problem-solving skills with a proven ability to diagnose root causes in complex, distributed systems. newJobs.title: Lead Quality Engineer
newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Sports is one of the internet’s leading destinations for comprehensive sports news and innovative fantasy games. We produce insightful content across multiple platforms and curate quality coverage from around the web to inform and entertain fans. We're an original fantasy sports pioneer, with a legacy of innovation that helps us continue to be a fantasy leader. And as one of the most-visited sports platforms on the internet, we're one of the best places for brands to reach fans. A Little About Us The Yahoo Sports Quality Engineering team architects the automated testing infrastructure, continuous integration quality gates, and performance validation engines that power our digital sports ecosystem. Operating across Web, iOS, Android, live scores, and fantasy platforms, our squad bridges software engineering and quality assurance to guarantee seamless, high-concurrency experiences for millions of active sports fans daily. Responsibilities Quality Framework Architecture: Architect, build, and maintain scalable, reusable test automation frameworks (Playwright, Appium, Cypress) and test utilities across Web, mobile (iOS/Android), API, and cloud services (IC5 level). AI-Augmented Quality Engineering: Architect and deploy AI-driven test automation pipelines (leveraging tools such as GitHub Copilot Enterprise and Anthropic Claude via AWS Bedrock) to automatically generate test cases, synthesize edge-case data, and accelerate automation script development. AI-Powered Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis: Build automated diagnostic engines that leverage AI and observability tools (Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk) to analyze execution failures, detect flaky test patterns, and automate root cause investigations. CI/CD Quality Gates & Release Assurance: Integrate automated functional, regression, integration, performance, and security testing directly into CI/CD pipelines, establishing deterministic quality gates for continuous deployment. Cross-Squad Quality Leadership: Collaborate upstream with Software Engineers, Architects, and Product Managers during design and code reviews to embed testability, contract validation, and risk mitigation early in the SDLC. Defect Triage & Observability Automation: Drive defect management and release risk assessments using AI-assisted triage tools (such as Atlassian AI) to map test coverage, classify regression trends, and optimize build stability. Engineering Standards & Mentorship: Establish enterprise-wide quality engineering standards, champion best practices in test design and contract testing, and mentor senior QEs across Yahoo Sports. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related technical discipline. 7+ years of professional experience in Quality Engineering or Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) roles, with a proven track record of architectural leadership. Hands-on proficiency with AI-assisted software development and testing tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLM-assisted script generation). Deep expertise in building modern, maintainable test automation frameworks using Playwright, Appium, Cypress, Selenium, or similar frameworks. Strong expertise in testing mobile applications (iOS/Android), consumer web applications, REST/GraphQL APIs, and microservice architectures. Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, Java, or scripting languages, with hands-on experience integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins). Demonstrated experience establishing quality metrics, performance/load testing strategies, and observability instrumentation (Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk). Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering. Experience evaluating or designing synthetic data generators and agentic AI test runners for high-concurrency mobile or web applications. Direct experience testing high-traffic, real-time streaming, or live sports scoring systems. A commitment to continuous learning and proactively evaluating emerging AI testing frameworks to elevate engineering velocity and product reliability. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

newJobs.descriptionText: Lead Engineer--Model-Based Design, Systems Verification & Validation Towson, MD Come make the world and accelerate your success. It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®. The Job: As a Lead Engineer, you’ll be part of our Electronics & Electrical team working as a hybrid employee. The Senior Project Engineer / Lead Engineer - Model-Based Design, Systems Verification & Validation will play a key role in advancing model-based development practices across the Electronics & Electrical Systems group. This role is focused on building and applying system models to support product development, requirements decomposition, system behavior definition, verification planning, and validation execution for electrical and electronic systems. The position is intended for an engineer with a strong foundation in Model-Based Design (MBD), systems engineering, and verification and validation (V&V), with the ability to support cross-functional teams through the full product development lifecycle. The engineer will work closely with development, testing, controls, hardware, firmware, and integration teams to improve design quality, accelerate issue resolution, and strengthen confidence in system performance before and during physical validation. This role is best suited for a senior-level engineer who can connect requirements, models, simulation results, and test outcomes into a structured development and validation framework, while helping teams adopt consistent and scalable MBD practices. You’ll get to: Lead and support model-based design activities for electrical and electronic systems, with emphasis on system behavior modeling, requirements alignment, and verification support. Develop and maintain system and subsystem models using MATLAB/Simulink/Stateflow, TwinBuilder, Dymola, Modelica, Ansys, LTSPice and related libraries/tools as appropriate. Use models to support requirements decomposition, interface definition, architecture evaluation, and early design verification. Define and execute verification and validation strategies that connect requirements, models, simulation outputs, and physical test results. Utilize simulation packages and define simulation process flows to rapidly identify root causes of Signal Integrity, ESD, & EMI related issues that arise during product development. Communicate and train the development engineers on how to apply these processes to his/her project. Support development teams by using models and simulations to evaluate concepts, identify design gaps, and reduce technical risk early in the product lifecycle. Support testing teams by helping define test cases, expected behaviors, acceptance criteria, and model-to-test correlation methods. Support integration teams by identifying subsystem interactions, interface issues, and system-level behavior risks before and during integration. Contribute to MIL, SIL, and HIL workflows where applicable to improve verification coverage and development efficiency. Analyze discrepancies between expected and observed system behavior and drive structured root cause investigation using model and test data. Help establish and improve MBD, verification, and validation best practices, workflows, templates, and reusable libraries across the organization. Collaborate with systems, controls, firmware, hardware, validation, and quality teams to ensure strong technical alignment throughout development. Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and contribute to design reviews, verification reviews, and cross-functional engineering decisions. The Person: You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have: Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field 8+ years of engineering experience in model-based design, systems engineering, verification and validation, controls development, or related product development environments Strong experience with MATLAB / Ability to translate system requirements into model structures, verification logic, and validation approaches Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience investigating complex system environments and associated workflows Experience with Embedded Coder or model-based implementation workflows Working knowledge of Python for scripting, automation, data analysis, or test support newJobs.title: Lead Engineer, Analytics Platform & AI
newJobs.descriptionText: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. Market Insights is Huron's analytics product suite, built on a foundation of tens of billions of medical claims, millions of clinical providers, and hundreds of millions of unique patient lives. We are looking for a Full Stack Lead Engineer to guide the technical direction of this platform end to end, from the data layer through the user interface, with a mandate to embed AI directly into how our analytics products are built and how they deliver insight to clients. This is a hands on leadership role. You will write and review code, set architecture and technical standards, and lead a team of engineers, while partnering closely with product management, data engineering, and data science to bring intelligent, AI enabled analytics capabilities to market faster. Responsibilities Full stack product development Lead design and development across the stack: responsive front end interfaces, APIs and services, and the underlying data layer for analytics products. Set technical direction and architecture for scalability, security, and performance of AWS based analytics solutions. Collaborate with product management on roadmap, prioritization, and feature delivery using Agile practices. AI and machine learning in analytics Identify and lead opportunities to embed AI and Agentic AI capabilities into analytics products: predictive models, natural language interfaces over data, automated insight generation, and generative AI features that help clients act faster on their data. Partner with data scientists to move machine learning models from prototype into reliable, production grade services. Evaluate and apply large language model based tools where they add measurable client value, with attention to data privacy, accuracy, and healthcare compliance requirements. Data engineering Design and maintain ETL and data pipeline processes that feed dashboards, models, and client facing reporting. Work with cloud data services, including S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, and Athena, to build scalable data infrastructure. Uphold data governance, quality, and healthcare data handling standards across the platform. Team leadership Support, and mentor a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and career development. Establish and continuously improve engineering practices, code quality standards, and delivery processes. Communicate progress, risks, and technical decisions clearly to product leadership and cross functional stakeholders. Qualifications Required: 8 or more years of professional software engineering experience, including full stack development across both front end and back end technologies. 3 or more years leading or mentoring engineers, formally or informally. Demonstrated experience applying AI or machine learning within a production analytics or data product, such as predictive modeling, recommendation systems, or generative AI features. Strong front end development skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, and React. Strong back end skills in Python, and an equivalent language used for analytics and API development. Solid understanding of relational databases and SQL. Working knowledge of core AWS services relevant to data and analytics, including Lambda, IAM, S3, Redshift, Glue, and Athena. Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation and the AWS CDK. Experience with version control systems, particularly Git. Experience delivering software using Agile methodologies.
