Job Description: Job Description - Intro Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is looking for a seasoned Software Engineer with a talent for developing software for the mainframe and leading a team dedicated to quality, security, and a smooth user experience. This role is in the Mainframe DevOps value stream, as a software engineer for one of our flagship products, Gen (formerly known as COOL:Gen or CA Gen). Gen is a low-code, model-driven development environment for enterprise applications. Gen enables global enterprises to generate and deploy applications in a single, integrated development environment for multiple platforms. Broadcom has earned scores of global Workplace Excellence awards in the last few years - and there's a reason for that. It’s our aim to encourage global collaboration and innovation while supporting and developing our talented workforce. Broadcom empowers its employees to drive success for both the business and themselves. We value a lean and flat organization, with team members who work in-office, for a more collaborative culture that focuses on execution and delivering value. #BroadcomSoftware The Opportunity As a Mainframe Software Engineer (ICB 5), you will take ownership of the development, core architecture, and ongoing evolution of Gen (formerly known as COOL: Gen or CA Gen). This is a high-impact, visible role where you will apply your advanced mainframe expertise to influence all levels of product delivery. You will guide architectural design, spearhead secure coding standards, and act as a technical mentor to other engineers. This is a hands-on technical role: you will write code, lead code reviews, and influence testing strategy. Concurrently, you will serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader in partnership with product management and customers. Work Location - ON SITE: 5465 Legacy Dr, Plano, TX 75024 Who You Are You are a self-motivated team player who likes diving into complex, legacy environments to modernize them in an ever-changing industry standards and customer needs. You collaborate easily with others, with an Agile mindset that makes communicating, responding to change, and continuous improvement a natural way of working for you. Your natural curiosity keeps you well informed of the latest technologies, and deepens your knowledge of legacy systems that are the foundation of global enterprise. What You’ll Do Research, develop, and implement high-quality, secure software solutions to maintain and enhance Gen's core product capabilities. Troubleshoot and fix customer cases that have been escalated to engineering. Drive technical design to ensure robust security standards, while retaining a simple user experience. Champion engineering excellence across the Mainframe Software Division, particularly for the DevOps value stream. Act as a public-facing subject matter expert by authoring technical blogs, webinars, and documentation on best practices. Offer thought leadership directly to enterprise customers, helping them navigate complex business requirements and advising them on Gen modernization strategies. What You Need 12+ years of experience in software development. Bachelors and/or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent degree. Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand complex component relationships. Ability to provide technical guidance and mentor software engineers. Growth mindset with a commitment to continuous personal and professional development. Deep expertise and hands-on coding experience in COBOL, IBM Assembler Experience working with middleware, such as ECI, TCP/IP or IBM MQ. Experience with zOS systems components and sub-systems such as: z/OS Language Environment (LE), ISPF, CICS, IMS, WebSphere Liberty, and DB2. Strong command of interlanguage communications (ILC) across hybrid environments. Expertise in deep-dive debugging, including reading system dumps, utilizing advanced diagnostic tools(like IPCS), and executing performance tuning. Experience with SMP/E or z/OSMF. Additional skills that will benefit your efforts Hands-on coding experience in: C, C++, Java, PL/I. Demonstrated experience implementing cybersecurity principles (e.g., cryptography, secure coding practices, access controls) and using industry-standard products like RACF, ACF2, Top Secret, and TLS. Experience in object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and Component Based Development (CBD) . Understanding of complex microservices, APIs, databases, and Client-Server communication. Experience with Source Code Management tools, such as Endevor and GitHub. newJobs.descriptionText: 岗位定位 面向电动工具及相关机电系统的下一代技术发展需求，负责先进控制理论、系统建模方法、CAE AI应用及模型驱动开发体系的研究与落地。该岗位将聚焦复杂机电系统的控制与建模前沿方向，探索可转化为产品竞争力和研发效率提升的关键技术，并推动相关研究成果在平台开发、新产品预研和软件开发流程中的工程化应用。 本岗位适合具有扎实控制理论基础、较强科研创新能力和工程转化意识的高层次博士人才。 核心职责 1. 前沿控制与系统建模研究 面向电动工具及相关复杂机电系统，开展先进控制理论、系统建模方法和智能化研发技术研究。 研究鲁棒控制、自适应控制、优化控制、智能控制、数据驱动建模等方向在实际产品中的应用潜力。 跟踪国内外前沿技术发展趋势，识别对未来产品平台和研发体系具有战略价值的关键技术方向。 2. CAE AI与智能工程方法探索 探索CAE与AI融合技术在产品设计、性能预测、参数优化、故障分析和研发提效中的应用。 推动仿真驱动、数据驱动和模型驱动方法在电动工具研发中的结合应用。 研究面向复杂系统的智能建模、代理模型、参数识别、虚拟验证等新方法。 3. 基于System Modeling的软件开发方法建设 推动基于System Modeling / Model-Based Development的软件开发方法在控制系统开发中的应用。 建立从系统需求、功能建模、控制设计、仿真验证到软件实现的开发流程与方法框架。 支持控制策略、系统架构和软件实现之间的一致性设计与验证。 4. 研究成果工程化转化 将前沿研究成果转化为可复用的研发方法、分析工具、建模规范、设计标准和技术平台能力。 支持研发团队将先进控制与建模方法应用于新产品开发、平台开发和关键技术攻关。 与机械、电子、电机、软件、测试等团队协同，推动研究成果在工程场景中的落地与验证。 5. 技术影响力与创新体系建设 参与或主导高水平技术课题、联合研究项目和外部技术合作。 推动专利、论文、技术白皮书、内部方法论和标准体系建设。 为团队提供系统控制、建模仿真和智能研发方向的技术指导，提升组织在前沿技术领域的能力积累。 任职资格 教育背景 博士学历，控制科学与工程、电气工程、自动化、系统工程、机电控制、机械电子工程或相关专业。 优先考虑国内外Top高校或知名研究团队背景。 研究与工作经验 具备先进控制、系统建模、模型驱动开发、智能控制、CAE相关方向的深入研究基础。 有复杂机电系统、电驱系统、机器人、汽车电控、工业装备、航空航天控制或相关领域研究/开发经验者优先。 具备将理论研究转化为工程方法、工具链或产品能力的经验者优先。 有高水平论文、核心专利、重大科研项目或产学研合作经历者优先。 专业能力 具备扎实的控制理论基础，对系统动力学、建模、控制与优化有深入理解。 熟悉一种或多种先进控制方法，如鲁棒控制、自适应控制、最优控制、预测控制、智能控制等。 熟悉系统建模、仿真分析和模型驱动开发方法，能够建立复杂系统的分析与设计框架。 了解CAE工具链、数据驱动方法、AI在工程研发中的应用逻辑。 具备较强的软件思维，理解控制算法到软件实现的转化过程。 具备优秀的科研能力、问题抽象能力、技术判断能力和跨团队协同能力。 优先条件 有MATLAB/Simulink、Modelica、AMESim、Ansys Twin Builder、Python或相关建模/仿真/算法工具使用经验。 有数字孪生、虚拟验证、代理模型、参数辨识、智能优化等方向经验者优先。 有电动工具、园林工具、手持设备或高动态机电产品相关经验者优先。 有技术路线规划、平台方法建设或研究团队带领经验者优先。 关键产出方向 前沿控制与系统建模方向的技术突破与方法沉淀 CAE AI与模型驱动开发在研发流程中的应用落地 支撑新产品平台开发的建模、分析与控制方法体系 高价值专利、论文、技术标准及内部研发资产 组织在先进控制与智能工程方向的能力提升 We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too. newJobs.title: Director, Software Apps Engineering – AI-Native Development and Product Experiences
newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. A Little About Us Yahoo is made up of several organizations, each led by a GM and focused on driving key product lines. This role sits within the Yahoo Mail group, home to our flagship product, Yahoo Mail. You’ll be joining a team — that has a great product line, with its 4.5+ star app experiences, strong business foundation, and robust technology, is well-positioned in the consumer communication space. Now, we’re entering our next chapter: building the most consumer-focused platform for managing the “business of life,” through email and beyond. You’ll join a team of engineers dedicated to delivering the best consumer mail experience, meticulously refining every detail to make that vision a reality. A Lot About You You’re an experienced engineering leader who loves building and empowering teams to create and maintain products that delight millions of users. You’re passionate about high-quality application development, technology stack, and the cloud - and you take pride in seeing your teams deliver great consumer experiences at scale. You know how to balance big-picture vision with hands-on leadership - guiding teams to think deeply about users, scenarios, and edge cases, while driving projects to successful completion. You lead with empathy and curiosity, create a culture of growth and collaboration, and understand the broader impact of great engineering on both people and the business. If you’re excited to join a world-class team of passionate engineers and industry veterans who care about code quality, design, and user experience as much as they enjoy working together - we’d love to talk to you. Responsibilities: Build, lead, and scale high-performing full-stack engineering teams that deliver world-class consumer products and experiences used by millions of customers globally. Define and execute the engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning technical investments with product priorities, business objectives, and long-term platform evolution. Drive AI-native software development practices across the organization, leveraging AI-powered tools, agents, automation, and modern engineering workflows to improve productivity, quality, and speed of execution. Lead AI transformation initiatives that reimagine how products are built, operated, and experienced, creating measurable value for users, developers, and the business. Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and business leaders to identify, prioritize, and deliver innovative AI-powered customer experiences that differentiate Yahoo Mail in the market. Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, experimentation, and continuous learning while attracting, developing, and retaining top engineering talent. Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and AI advancements, guiding architectural decisions, technical reviews, and strategic investments that enable scalable and responsible innovation. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of experience building and delivering large-scale consumer software products, with at least 5+ years leading multiple engineering teams and engineering managers. Proven success leading engineering organizations that consistently deliver high-quality products while balancing innovation, execution, operational excellence, and business outcomes. Experience leading AI-native product organizations or large-scale AI transformation programs within consumer technology companies. Demonstrated experience operating in an AI-native development environment and leveraging modern AI technologies, copilots, agents, and automation to transform engineering workflows. Proven track record leading AI transformation initiatives that have delivered measurable improvements in developer productivity, customer experience, operational efficiency, or business performance. Strong technical expertise in modern application development, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, mobile and web platforms, and scalable software design. Hands-on experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java, Kotlin, Swift, or similar technologies, with the ability to engage deeply in technical discussions and architectural decisions. Experience integrating Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning capabilities, or intelligent agent systems into products, platforms, or engineering processes. Strong business acumen with the ability to identify and prioritize opportunities where AI can create competitive advantage, accelerate growth, improve customer engagement, and unlock operational efficiencies. Exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with demonstrated ability to influence across functions, drive organizational change, and build high-performing, inclusive teams in fast-paced environments. Preferred Qualifications: Experience building, scaling, or modernizing email, messaging, communications, or productivity platforms serving millions of users. Recognized thought leadership in AI strategy, engineering productivity, platform modernization, or organizational transformation. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

The Job: As a Sr Director, Systems Engineering, you’ll be part of our Engineering & Technology – Americas & EMEA team working as a hybrid employee. This role will report directly to the Vice President, Engineering & Technology (Americas & EMEA) and will lead two sub-groups: a team of embedded Systems Engineers deployed to programs and the Engineering Processes & Quality group, which owns stage-gate technical readiness, engineering quality audits, and engineering standard work. You’ll get to: Build and lead the Systems Engineering capability for the Americas and EMEA engineering organization, including defining the operating model, engagement model with programs, and standard ways of working for embedded Systems Engineers deployed to programs. Recruit, develop, and deploy Systems Engineers who partner with program teams to lead requirements decomposition, interface control, integration analysis, and system-level technical readiness activities. Lead the implementation of systems-engineering methods, tools, and standard work across programs, including requirements management, traceability, and model-based systems engineering practices from customer need through verification. Drive verification and validation rigor by ensuring programs establish clear V&V plans, test coverage against critical-to-quality requirements, and evidence-based design review gates. Establish and scale the organization’s design-risk and functional-safety analysis discipline by driving consistent hazard analysis, DFMEA, and fault-tree analysis in partnership with Electrical Engineering and other functional teams. Lead the Engineering Processes & Quality group in deploying stage-gate technical readiness expectations, engineering quality audits, and engineering standard work across Americas and EMEA design centers in alignment with broader Engineering Excellence direction. Drive the Lead Project Engineer transformation by coaching design-center leaders and engineering teams to expand lead engineering accountability to full system ownership across mechanical, electrical, software, and industrial design. Connect systems-engineering rigor to measurable business outcomes by improving requirements discipline, architecture decisions, design reuse, and technical readiness in support of productivity and cost objectives. Define, monitor, and communicate leading indicators such as technical readiness at gate, design review effectiveness, requirements traceability, escape rate, and rework driven by integration failures. Operate as a peer to Design Center leaders and influence adoption of systems-engineering rigor through technical credibility, clarity, and practical implementation support. The Person: You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. newJobs.title: VP, Marketing Science & Analytics
newJobs.descriptionText: GoodRx is the leading prescription savings platform in the U.S. Trusted by more than 25 million consumers and 750,000 healthcare professionals annually, GoodRx provides access to savings and affordability options for generic and brand-name medications at more than 70,000 pharmacies nationwide, as well as comprehensive healthcare research and information. Since 2011, GoodRx has helped consumers save nearly $75 billion on the cost of their prescriptions. Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans. About the Role: As the VP, Marketing Science & Analytics you will lead and manage a team of 10 to drive business growth through data. The role includes broad responsibility for centralizing customer segmentation strategy for media activation and growth, marketing analytics and BI, privacy and regulatory compliance, ad operations, and programmatic media strategy and activation. Your role is pivotal in shaping our marketing science vision, fostering innovation, and ensuring seamless collaboration with cross-functional teams. This role owns and drives the data-driven marketing vision within the marketing team. Key Responsibilities: 1. Team Leadership and Development: Lead a team of 10+, while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Oversee the recruitment, training, and development of marketing science talent. Follow all company and team guidelines and processes regarding talent management and team goal setting, tracking, and attainment. 2. Relationship Building, Strategic Planning, and Enterprise Alignment: Build/maintain strong relationships with data, engineering, finance, and other team leaders in and outside of marketing. Collaborate cross-functionally to provide consistent, reliable metrics, support decision-making, and guide strategic planning. Communicate plans effectively and secure enterprise alignment for initiatives. 3. Data-driven Activation - Programmatic Media Channels and Audience Strategy: Responsible for programmatic media, optimizing audience strategy for effective marketing campaigns, and developing optimization feedback loops from program data. Develop new data product capabilities to automate workflows that power programmatic media and data collection. Building for scale, while remaining flexible to accommodate different use cases and business goals. 4. Customer Segmentation and Marketing Automation: Develop customer segmentation approach for audience selection, including technical requirements for managing audiences, and strategies for personalized marketing activation and improved customer experience. Drive marketing automation around customer lifecycle touchpoints to enhance customer insights and business predictions for Next Best Actioning. 5. Marketing Analytics and Business Intelligence: Lead marketing attribution efforts, including the integration of lift measurement, econometric modeling, and channel measurement to assess the impact of various marketing channels and guide optimization decisions. Develop and refine strategies for measuring the effectiveness of marketing initiatives and optimizing budget/time allocation. Own all reporting and insights generation for the marketing department, assessing stakeholder needs and establishing the right reporting cadence and depth of insight to meet daily business decision making requirements. Compiles roll-up reports for department-wide view of business unit performance for team business review meetings, partner reporting needs, ELT meetings, board presentations, and other ad-hoc needs. Works closely with the consumer insights team to make proactive recommendations to marketing stakeholders and goes beyond reporting metrics to providing business context and explanations for material changes in the data over time (including technical measurement issues or methodology changes). Effectively communicate marketing measurement methodology to and aligns with cross functional partners. 6. Ad Operations, Privacy, Legal Compliance, and Martech Strategy: Take ownership of ad operations to ensure seamless execution of advertising campaigns. Ensure privacy and legal compliance in all marketing activities, staying abreast of industry regulations and internal process changes. Develop and implement Martech (Marketing Technology) strategies aligned with marketing science goals. Oversee the evaluation and integration of marketing technologies to enhance efficiency. 7. Continuous Improvement: Stay up-to-date with industry-standard processes and new technologies (especially AI) in marketing science and implement improvements as needed to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of marketing data analysis. Skills & Qualifications: Bachelor's degree or above in a relevant field (e.g., Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or other science). 20+ years of experience in marketing science, value measurement, audience profiling, performance media, and experience with AI tools Tech-driven Healthcare and/or Retail experience a plus. Strong knowledge of statistics for marketing data interpretation and modeling. Experience in pipeline management to ensure data flow and integrity. Proficiency in data visualizations to effectively communicate marketing insights. Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide a marketing science team. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with ability to find truth through data and use that understanding to drive organizational alignment from within marketing. Willingness to travel as needed to meet marketing goals Engineering teams are responsible for supporting appropriate security controls, including management, operational, and technical controls in addition to general GoodRx best practices, such as reading and adhering to the security policies and procedures, being vigilant and observant of potential security threats, etc. At GoodRx, pay ranges are determined based on work locations and may vary based on where the successful candidate is hired. newJobs.descriptionText: Electro-Mechanical Engineer Location Towson, MD Come build something that matters. It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®. The Job: As a Electro-Mechanical Engineer, you’ll be part of our power tools engineering team working as a hybrid employee. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in designing and developing integrated electro-mechanical systems for motor-driven and power conversion applications. Advanced proficiency in 3D modeling, mechanical design, and the integration of electronic and mechanical components is essential. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including electrical, firmware, manufacturing, and compliance to deliver innovative, reliable, and robust solutions for our next-generation power tools. Experienced candidates will be expected to apply industry best practices, support product development from concept through mass production, and ensure all designs meet stringent quality, safety, and regulatory standards. You’ll get to: Design and develop innovative, reliable, and safe electro-mechanical systems and motor controls using 3D modeling and detailed drawings, managing BOMs and documentation in PLM systems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product Management, Industrial Design, Reliability, Compliance, Sourcing, Manufacturing) to define product requirements, "Critical to Quality" attributes, and ensure robust product development. Release comprehensive product specifications, RFQ packets, and costed BOMs; partner with suppliers and contract manufacturers to achieve optimal cost, quality, and timely delivery. Contribute to development of electro-mechanical modules for power electronics and power tool applications supporting both high-mix and low-volume production. Conduct tolerance stack-ups, DFMEA, PFMEA, process control plans, and release engineering changes to support robust product development. Perform engineering analyses (structural, thermal, airflow, FEA), design validation, and advanced testing to optimize product performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Drive root cause analysis and continuous improvement for manufacturing, assembly, and product performance issues. Support manufacturing and DFM initiatives. Ensure compliance with safety, regulatory, and quality standards. Support regulatory documentation and reporting. Support multiple projects, meeting schedule, cost, and quality objectives, and provide regular status updates to management. Conduct tolerance stack-ups, DFMEA, PFMEA, process control plans, and release engineering changes to support robust product development. The Person: You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have: B.S. in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline required 3-5 years of experience in product development of high-volume electronic modules and assemblies. Proficient in 3D modeling software (CATIA preferred); ability to generate detailed 2D drawings. Familiarity with printed circuit board design and integration. Working knowledge of manufacturing processes for electronic and other products. Demonstrated ability to design plastic and metallic components, working with a variety of materials. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, and failure analysis. Experience with supplier development and working with contract manufacturers for key components. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet schedule and cost commitments. Excellent communication skills for effective interaction with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams. Strong commitment to quality and continuous improvement; understanding of quality, performance, schedule, and cost objectives in a cross-functional environment. Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship (H1B, OPT/CPT, TN etc). The Details: You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including: Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being. Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs. And More: We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to: Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths. Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal. Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences. Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices. What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us! #LI-NM1 #LI-Hybrid The Salary range for this position is $72,000.00 - $115,900.00 This is the lowest to highest annual full-time salary range we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights. Who We Are We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company. What You’ll Also Get Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths. Benefits & Perks You’ll get a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits plan that includes medical, dental, life, vision, wellness program, disability, retirement benefits, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Paid Time Off, including paid vacation, holidays & personal days, and tuition reimbursement. And, of course, discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and products and well as discount programs for many other vendors and partners. Learning & Development: Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities). Diverse & Inclusive Culture: We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too. Purpose-Driven Company: You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.
